note: Phase 9 Deployment is cascade rename of old Phase 7 + Shape A scope refinement. Owner: @devops. Verification + execution + recording (no spec authoring; no forward-carry mechanism per Q3). Pre-deploy gate (5 checks) + deploy action + post-deploy gate (3 checks) per Q2.
entry_conditions: All stories complete; tests passing; implementation-deltas resolved

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/audit/readiness-v{latest}.md` exists with status: pass — the scripted hard checklist: build, env-vs-manifest, npm audit (high/critical) + security/scan-* suite, SBOM, security headers, license, Lighthouse vs budgets, T2 lockfile pinning
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@devops readiness` to verify all readiness aspects.

acceptance_checks.description: Env vs baseline verification passes (DNS, SSL, env vars, secrets)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@devops env-check`. Fix env config OR Phase 3 baseline re-entry.

acceptance_checks.description: The security/scan-* suite (Semgrep SAST + OSV + Trivy → normalised ScanResult) aggregates to exit 0; readiness runs this + npm audit (high/critical). LLM gates are separate acceptance checks.
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run the `security/scan-*` suite via `aggregate-gate-results`; block-severity findings → Phase 8 re-entry. (npm-audit + dep-health folded into `readiness`.)

acceptance_checks.description: (Brownfield only) `_context/audit/db-migration-check-v{latest}.md` exists with status: pass; greenfield projects skip silently
`_context/tracking/deploy-log-v{latest}.md` records deploy completion with status: success
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@devops deploy`. Failures trigger rollback procedure.
If smoke fails: rollback + Phase 8 re-entry to fix.

acceptance_checks.description: Observability exporter ingesting per `coldpress.yaml baselines.observability_axis` (if declared)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Verify observability pipeline. Phase 3 baseline re-entry if revision needed.

acceptance_checks.description: secrets-vault-manager scan completed; zero CRITICAL findings (no committed secrets, manifest-vs-env consistent)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@devops secrets-vault-manager`. Resolve CRITICAL findings via emitted rotation runbook before deploy.

acceptance_checks.description: readiness (incl. dependency audit) completed; no GPL/AGPL transitive deps; no Critical/High CVE without remediation plan
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@devops readiness` (absorbs dependency-auditor). License-block findings BLOCK deploy; CVE remediations follow ranked priority list.

acceptance_checks.description: observability-designer has emitted observability-v{N}.md + alert/dashboard/sampling configs (vendor-neutral)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@devops observability-designer` to draft SLO/SLI/alerts/dashboards. Wiring to vendor backend deferred to Phase 10.
